data.name: Georgina
data.gender_notes: Georgina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Farm worker, tiller of the soil
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Georgios, meaning farmer or earth-worker. The name became popular in the Western world due to the veneration of St. George, a Christian martyr and soldier. Georgina is a feminine variant of the name and is often given to girls in honor of the saint. The name Georgina carries the meaning “Farm worker, tiller of the soil” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Georgina usually hope their child will grow to embody farm worker, tiller of the soil and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the earth and the hardworking spirit of those who cultivate it.
data.etymology: Georgina belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Farm worker, tiller of the soil.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Georgina total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
